Frozen Strawberry Pie
By: Amy Jeanroy
Published: Sunday, July 3, 2011 - 6:27pm

Ingredients




2 egg whites
3/4 cup sugar
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 tablespoon lemon juice
1 cup sliced fresh strawberries
1 teaspoon vanilla
1 cup whipping cream
Graham cracker crust

Preparation

1 Beat egg whites and sugar until very stiff peaks form. 2 Mix in remaining ingredients except the cream 3 Whip cream 4 Fold whipped cream into all  other ingredients 5 Pour into crust 6 Freeze 7 Serve straight from the freezer
